ddsinfo [options] <paths>

ddsinfo Usage:

ddsinfo operates on all images specified on the command line, or on all
images within directories specified on the command line.

options:
        --version|-v    Display version information
        --help|-h               Display this usage information
        --recurse|-r            Recurse into subdirectories
        --dimensions|-d Display image dimensions
        --compression|-c        Display image compression method
        --filter|-f [filter]    Use filter as wildcard for file search (e.g. *.dds)

        E.g. ddsinfo -r -c -d .
